summary: We are developing a spacecraft mission game to provide an interactive 3D rover simulation about managing limited resources and completing tasks in space, which are created by real NASA data and conditions. We aim to make it fun, but also educational. Simultaneously, we want it to be motivation for the youth to pursue that kind of career path.
details: This project is aimed to work as an tool to experience space conditions in a 3D roversimulation. The impact and things we considered are fun, creativity about space environments and exploring. It's meant to teach and be played as an game. The tools used are Godot Game Engine, Blender, NASA API's
